name: zenzawatch-typescript-stage1
description: Isolated TypeScript/JSDoc migration proof; never wired into legacy build.js

scripts.check: tsc --project tsconfig.checkjs.json && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project tsconfig.style-contract.json && tsc --project tsconfig.raf.contract.json
scripts.advanced:types: tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.contract.json && node scripts/check-model-strict.mjs && node scripts/check-config-strict.mjs && node scripts/check-legacy-panel-strict.mjs && node scripts/check-ui-strict.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.core-strict.json && tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.screenshot-strict.json && tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.related-order-strict.json && tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.composite-rules-strict.json && tsc --project tsconfig.advanced.ng-editor-strict.json
scripts.advanced:verify: npm run advanced:emit && npm run advanced:types && node scripts/sync-advanced.mjs --check
scripts.nico:sync: npm run nico:emit && node scripts/sync-nico-api.mjs --write && npm run scui:sync
scripts.nico:verify: npm run nico:emit && npm run nico:types && node scripts/sync-nico-api.mjs --check && npm run scui:verify
scripts.generate:legacy: npm run build && node scripts/sync-all.mjs --write && npm run advanced:sync && npm run nico:sync
scripts.verify:legacy: node scripts/sync-all.mjs --check && npm run advanced:verify && npm run nico:verify
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run verify:legacy && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.scui:verify: npm run scui:emit && tsc --project tsconfig.scene-contracts.json && node scripts/sync-scui.mjs --check
